description: This file defines a React functional component named ProductGrid that renders a grid layout of product cards. It imports React, a child component ProductCard, and CSS styling. The component displays a message when there are no products and maps over the products array to render ProductCard components for each product.

methods.name: ProductGrid({ products, onAdd })
methods.description: A React functional component that displays a grid of products or a 'No products found' message if the list is empty.
